cross_branch_contradictions.statement: A single Clay semantic world could be mistaken for a single physical database.
cross_branch_contradictions.resolution: REJECT_COLLAPSE; preserve one semantic/query contract while physical placement remains per-subplan and benchmark-gated.

cross_branch_contradictions.statement: Global all-store freshness could be mistaken for required consistency.
cross_branch_contradictions.resolution: Use operation-specific consistency domains and basis witnesses; unrelated churn must not invalidate an operation.

cross_branch_contradictions.statement: Authentic records could be mistaken for authentic retrieval/selection.
cross_branch_contradictions.resolution: Bind query-plan and candidate-set identity in selection receipts.

cross_branch_contradictions.statement: Associative activation could be mistaken for fact truth or authority.
cross_branch_contradictions.resolution: Activation/vector/FTS remain derived non-authoritative routes; exact anchors validate effect-critical use.

cross_branch_contradictions.statement: Strong cross-store atomicity could be assumed across arbitrary attached engines.
cross_branch_contradictions.resolution: Use one authoritative commit domain plus durable derivation/outbox receipts unless a target engine proves true atomicity for the whole effect-critical scope.

source_concept_import: Persistent Clay state should continue evolving between model calls so related memory can influence the next Assembly without requiring explicit top-k memory-tool invocation every time.
promotion_boundary: No strong promotion; first dedicated UnifiedDB run uses synthetic/local database evidence and external systems literature, not live FRANK/Android/target-Qwen production evidence.
